summary: Combine complex coil images into one image using scan-bound sensitivity maps.
notes: Sensitivity-map estimation belongs to the planned org.kspacejet.calibration/sensitivity_map_estimate Operator. This consumer must receive its immutable sensitivity maps through a future explicit calibration binding, never by inferring or retaining hidden shared Provider state. The future contract must define artifact-identity matching, output semantics, resource bounds, cancellation, and terminal behavior.
